description: Start monitoring ONE French company for 90 days. BODACC is checked every 3 hours; each NEW notice (safeguard, receivership, liquidation, plan, closure, deregistration) published after the start creates an alert. Notices already published are not alerted: use verifier_entreprise for the current state. Delivery: if `webhook` (public HTTPS URL) is given, each alert is POSTed as JSON with the header X-Verif-Signature = sha256=HMAC-SHA256(body, jeton). In every case, alerts can be polled at the returned `suivi` URL (free). Keep the returned `jeton`: it signs webhooks and gives access to the alerts. Errors (never charged): an invalid SIREN, a non-public webhook or an unknown company returns an error and is not settled. Payment: $0.1 per company via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). No account or API key.

siren.description: SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits) of the company to monitor.

webhook.description: Optional public HTTPS URL that receives each alert (signed POST JSON).
